preconditions.description: The number of chairs n is between 2 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= e <= n and s != e
preconditions.description: Start s and end e are valid chair indices between 1 and n, and they are distinct.

preconditions.expression: len(x) == n and all(1 <= x[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n)) and all(x[i] < x[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: The list x contains n strictly increasing integers representing chair coordinates, each between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and len(b) == n and len(c) == n and len(d) == n and all(1 <= v <= 10**9 for v in a) and all(1 <= v <= 10**9 for v in b) and all(1 <= v <= 10**9 for v in c) and all(1 <= v <= 10**9 for v in d)
preconditions.description: The lists a, b, c, and d each contain n integers between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output is the string representation of the minimum time required to visit every chair exactly once starting at s and ending at e.

postconditions.expression: min_time == min(cost_of_path(p) for p in valid_paths)
postconditions.description: The value min_time is the minimum total cost among all valid paths that visit every chair exactly once, starting at s and ending at e.

postconditions.expression: all(set(p) == set(range(1, n+1)) and p[0] == s and p[-1] == e for p in valid_paths)
postconditions.description: A valid path is a permutation of all chair indices from 1 to n that starts at s and ends at e.

postconditions.expression: cost_of_path(p) == sum((abs(x[p[i]-1] - x[p[i+1]-1]) + (c[p[i]-1] + b[p[i+1]-1] if p[i+1] < p[i] else d[p[i]-1] + a[p[i+1]-1])) for i in range(len(p)-1))
postconditions.description: The cost of a path is the sum of jump costs between consecutive chairs, where jumping left (j < i) costs |xi - xj| + ci + bj, and jumping right (j > i) costs |xi - xj| + di + aj.
